caseName: North Shore University Hospital v. New York State Human Rights Appeal Board
caseNameFull: North Shore University Hospital v. New York State Human Rights Appeal Board
judges: Appeal, Dismiss, Jurisdiction, Question, Set, Want, Would

opinions.text:
Appeal from App. Div., Sup. Ct. N. Y., 2d Jud. Dept., dismissed for want of jurisdiction.

Justice Blackmun would dismiss the appeal for want of substantial federal question. Justice Stevens would note probable jurisdiction and set case for oral argument.
